audit_kind: Non-voting final delivery visual QA; not an additional scholarly round
summary: All eleven pages of the actual published PDF were visually inspected. No clipping, overlap, unreadable mathematical glyph, broken table continuation or source/receipt inconsistency was observed. No delivery repair is required within this inspection scope.
inspection_method: Called view_image on each of the eleven actual publication-audit PNGs. Independently rerasterized report.pdf with Poppler at 90 dpi in a temporary directory; all eleven resulting PNG hashes matched the inspected images. No prior-preview image was substituted.

findings.observation: Margins, headings, footers and page transitions are readable. No clipping, text overlap or missing-glyph box was observed. The long source paragraph remains continuous on page 2; the conclusion is complete on page 9.

The maximum-size bound and forcing threshold remain distinct. Set difference, bracket indices, semicolon anchor arguments and N[max]/N[R]/μ are visible. The coefficient maximum, inequality directions, strict-comparison and no-rounding caveats survive. Both negative numerators on page 6 retain their minus signs. Theorem 2 retains its maximum/existence definition; root-degree caps and the A3 positivity chain remain legible. The conclusion visibly says under μ ≥ 41.

The orbit and root-case tables retain their row/column associations. The companion table continues on page 11 with its header repeated, readable filenames and complete conclusions. No row content overlaps a border or footer.

Historical H27 authentication, literature-search coverage, non-end-to-end formal verification and local-review limitations remain visible. The receipt generic MathML wording is not taken as evidence of semantic tagging; its explicit literal-Unicode limitations control this audit.

receipt_and_text_checks.independent_text_check_scope: Re-extracted all PDF text and matched its receipt hash; independently checked selected mathematical and caveat tokens. Did not perform a second exhaustive 206-fragment comparison.
receipt_and_text_checks.link_check_method: CommonMark link parsing, HTML anchor parsing and Poppler pdfinfo -url annotations.

limitations: Visual inspection covers the supplied 765-by-990-pixel, 90-dpi rasterization of all eleven published pages and selected text/token checks; it is not a universal semantic-equivalence proof.
Mathematics retains literal Unicode and bracketed-index notation. No semantic mathematics tagging or accessibility conformance is certified.
This delivery QA is non-voting and does not add a scholarly review, establish mathematical correctness or supply independent human certification.
Link targets were compared across the delivered formats; their external availability or contents were not re-audited.
